propositions: rebar comment silently stores flag-like tokens (e.g. '--body-file') as the comment body instead of rejecting them, discarding the actual intended content while exiting with code 0

positional-body commands (comment, tag, untag, archive, session-log, create, edit, set-verify-commands) lack validation to reject arguments beginning with '-', allowing flag tokens to be misinterpreted as body content
surplus positional arguments after a flag-looking token are dropped by argument slicing, compounding the data loss and making the failure doubly silent
users cannot reliably write body text that legitimately begins with '-' due to lack of standard escape hatch (e.g. '--' separator)
the silent failure mode is undetectable via exit code, stderr, comment count checks, and only surfaces when content is later read by downstream verification gates
